source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 GPT-J 99 Offline and compare with MLCommons v4.0.
procedure_facts: The command `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=gptj --scenarios=offline` has no closing quote.
Later text asks for a valid BERT result and the Script field points to a Llama2-70B 99.9 repository.
criteria_facts: Greater than an unspecified official NVIDIA MLPerf score.
source_conflicts: GPT-J conflicts with BERT and Llama2 references.
The run command is syntactically incomplete.
The comparison lacks a matching GPT-J 99 Offline result/system ID.
missing_source_information: Pinned GPT-J model/CNN-DailyMail data, preprocessing and v4.0 harness.
Accuracy/performance/compliance commands and comparable samples/s rule.

original_test_intent.statement: Run a valid MLPerf Inference v4.0 GPT-J normal-accuracy 99 Offline benchmark, prove GPT-J accuracy and LoadGen/compliance validity, and compare Offline throughput with an approved comparable v4.0 result.
must_preserve: GPT-J-specific accuracy plus valid LoadGen evidence.
Whole-system GPU workload and comparable reference.
must_not_infer: That the malformed command is executable.
That any NVIDIA score is comparable or that a local run is official.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly detects the unclosed quote, GPT-J/BERT conflict and Server/Offline ambiguity, and requires valid GPT-J Offline artifacts and evidence.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not identify the unrelated Llama2 Script field or bind GPT-J acceptance to its model-specific accuracy evidence and a named comparable v4.0 Offline result.

related_records: DLRM and Llama rows cannot supply GPT-J model, dataset, accuracy metric or result reference.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Title and scenario identify GPT-J 99 Offline, but the broken command and wrong-model references require a formal rewrite before execution.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The source command cannot be executed and its BERT/Llama references are wrong. Rewrite it around a pinned GPT-J 99 Offline v4.0 implementation and comparable result before automation.

conditions_present: The title consistently names GPT-J 99 Offline.
missing: Correct executable command/script, GPT-J artifacts/licenses/configs, accuracy/compliance phases, reference ID, threshold and platform limits.
provider: Benchmark owner rewrites command and signs reference.
Data/software owners supply GPT-J model and CNN/DailyMail-derived data under approved terms.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory platform and inspect hashes/licenses/config manifests and published GPT-J v4.0 result metadata.
prohibited_until_resolved: Execute malformed command, use BERT/Llama assets, download licensed artifacts, tune/run, clear logs or PASS.
closure_evidence: Correct GPT-J-only command and Script reference.
Pinned v4.0 artifacts/configs and valid accuracy/compliance procedure.
Comparable Offline result ID and numeric rule.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 GPT-J 99 Offline
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v4.0 GPT-J normal-accuracy Offline configuration, verify GPT-J accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure Offline throughput, and compare only with a signed comparable v4.0 GPT-J result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SUT/GPU topology, driver/runtime, container/harness commit, GPT-J model, approved CNN/DailyMail evaluation data/preprocessing and v4.0 configs. Vendor implementations and model variants are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All resources declared by the system configuration; GPT-J 99; Offline only. GPT-J 99.9, Server, BERT, Llama2 and DLRM are excluded.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected checksummed script/command; pinned v4.0 harness/container; licensed GPT-J model/data/preprocessing hashes; system/user/mlperf configs; GPT-J AccuracyOnly, PerformanceOnly and compliance procedures; approved tuning/cooling/power; comparable result ID; numeric throughput/accuracy/validity/health rules.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify artifacts/configs and baseline health, then execute GPT-J 99 Offline accuracy, performance and required compliance phases using the pinned implementation. Preserve complete LoadGen and GPT-J accuracy logs and telemetry. Never execute the unclosed source command or substitute the linked Llama2 script/BERT check.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Formal rewrite completed; artifacts licensed and pinned; full GPU visibility; sufficient memory/storage/cooling/power; no competing workload; tuning and recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/config and GPU topology; all binary/container/harness/model/data hashes; exact commands/configs; GPT-J accuracy output; LoadGen detail/summary/accuracy logs; valid Offline throughput; required compliance output; power/thermal/XID/ECC/host logs; named comparable result and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v4.0 GPT-J 99 Offline rules and identified comparable result. Pass requires GPT-J accuracy validity, valid LoadGen/compliance, numeric Offline comparison and clean platform health. BERT accuracy, Llama2 logs, Server metrics or command exit alone are invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not run malformed or wrong-model commands, mix 99/99.9 or Server/Offline, use unlicensed artifacts, copy unmatched tuning, alter clocks/power without approval, suppress invalidity, clear logs or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/software/platform owners approve rewrite, artifacts, reference, tuning and load; a human judges comparability and final disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans correct the source and select acceptance. The Agent may run only the pinned GPT-J workflow after gates and cannot repair intent at runtime.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On invalidity or platform limit, preserve evidence, stop the harness/container, restore tuning/services and verify GPU/host health before a separately approved rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Malformed/wrong-model command remains; wrong scenario/accuracy/release; missing license/config/reference; accuracy/LoadGen/compliance failure; topology drift; XID/ECC/thermal/power/storage/host limit; monitoring/evidence loss.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation was CLEAR. The validator preserved MLPerf v4.0 GPT-J normal-accuracy 99 Offline only; rejected BERT/Llama, 99.9, Server, malformed-command carryover and release/config drift; required GPT-J accuracy, LoadGen performance-validity and applicable compliance evidence; retained licensed-artifact, tuning, comparable-reference, recovery and health gates; and rejected partial, official or PASS claims. No material document defect was found. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.
